prompts: Create ONE high fidelity desktop website hero mockup, wide landscape 16:9, crisp legible Vietnamese typography, no browser chrome, no annotations, no collage. Reference image shows existing Flamee brand, cream autumn background and open couple journal: preserve those visual assets and brand cues faithfully. Include slim header with orange Flamee logo on left, brown nav 'Kỷ niệm', 'Kết nối', 'Câu hỏi', light cream outlined 'Gói thành viên' button on right. Cream linen #F2EDE6, chestnut #49382F, terracotta #AC603D, muted brown #78685D, peach #F5E5D6, coral accent #FF7158. Refined Cormorant Garamond serif headline and Be Vietnam Pro sans body. Deliberately balanced hero typography and open scrapbook photos, not tiny text beside giant image. Accurate Vietnamese diacritics. No extra sections. Layout is an actionable design proposal for the existing site. DIRECTION 1: A personal letter to one's partner. Left ~52% holds an intimate but confident editorial message, right ~48% a substantial open journal, aligned as one scene. Small 2-line uppercase eyebrow 'ỨNG DỤNG DÀNH CHO CÁC CẶP ĐÔI' / 'KẾT NỐI TÌNH CẢM'. Large upright headline first line 'Có những ngày bình thường,' then a slightly wider italic terracotta line 'chỉ muốn giữ cùng bạn.' Both headline lines similar size, naturally expanding silhouette. Body beneath with deliberate breathing room, readable full exact text: 'Một tấm ảnh chụp vội, vài dòng kể cuối ngày, một cảm xúc chưa kịp nói. Flamee giữ những điều nhỏ ấy trong không gian riêng của hai người.' Set body in 3 controlled lines, not a narrow column. Primary CTA terracotta pill, cream label 'KHÁM PHÁ FLAMEE', small cream/peach circular arrow inset on right, refined not bulky. Warm autumn leaves softly frame edges. Premium romantic personal-letter feeling, excellent optical alignment.
